entities.name: RlmN RNA methyltransferase
observations: The 385-residue query sequence matches reviewed RlmN homologs at 61.8–62.6% identity with 91.4–94.8% query coverage and E-values of 3.72e-160 to 9.32e-164.
RlmN is annotated as a dual-specificity radical-SAM RNA methyltransferase that methylates adenosine at position 2503 of 23S rRNA and position 37 of tRNA.
The annotation evidence is moderate homology support, not direct experimental characterization of the supplied sequence.

entities.name: RlmN adenosine C2 methylation
observations: SAM-dependent radical methylation converts adenosine to 2-methyladenosine in 23S rRNA A2503 or tRNA A37.

The reaction uses two SAM molecules per modified nucleotide in the retrieved Rhea formulations, producing 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, and S-adenosylhomocysteine; reduced/oxidized iron-sulfur electron-transfer species are also represented.
Exact substrate choice between 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37 cannot be established from sequence alone.

entities.name: RlmN [4Fe-4S] cofactor
observations: RlmN homologs bind one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines, with an exchangeable SAM ligand; this is characteristic of radical-SAM catalysis.
